title: Choices made when the front end and back end first ran together
decision: The Mini App exchanges its sign-in data once and keeps the session token in memory and in sessionStorage, so that a reload does not sign the person out now that sign-in data is accepted once; the panels sign in through the Telegram widget's redirect instead of a callback, so no eval is allowed, and the signed fields are accepted only on a navigation from our own site, judged by the referrer, which locks out a browser that sends none; the end-to-end suite lives in its own package and runs on every pull request
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 65
rationale: The alternative to sessionStorage is to accept sign-in data more than once, which reopens finding 9
